items.title: Apply the hardened codex/gemini extractors + recordDispatchFinalForProvider unavailable-on-throw
items.context: Apply the reviewed cumulative fix to packages/main/src/providers/codex-cli.ts (extractCodexUsage: own-property ownProp guards on every usage read; pickCodexUsageKeys returns Object.create(null) with only prompt_tokens/completion_tokens/prompt_tokens_details; sanitizeNestedDetails null-protos the nested prompt_tokens_details), packages/main/src/providers/gemini-cli.ts (extractGeminiUsage: ownProp guards; pickGeminiUsageKeys returns Object.create(null) with only promptTokenCount/candidatesTokenCount/cachedContentTokenCount), and packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger/dispatch-usage.ts (recordDispatchFinalForProvider: inner try around buildProviderRecord+append; on throw fall through to one unavailable-final that supersedes the estimate; outer never-throws kept). The exact final file contents are captured in /tmp/fe1f-final/. Do NOT change recordDispatchFinal (anthropic), parseClaudeCliOutput, buildProviderRecord, the adapters, or import usage-ledger into providers/.
items.userSees: A codex/gemini usage with an extra/inherited non-token key yields a null-prototype reportedUsage carrying only numeric token fields; a malformed-but-object usage records an unavailable-final that supersedes the estimate.

happy.desc: A normal codex (openai) usage {prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, prompt_tokens_details:{cached_tokens}} projects to a null-prototype reportedUsage carrying exactly those token keys; cacheRead survives.
A normal gemini usage {promptTokenCount, candidatesTokenCount, cachedContentTokenCount} projects to a null-prototype reportedUsage carrying exactly those keys.

edge.desc: A usage carrying an extra non-token key (e.g. transcript) drops it; only adapter-read token keys reach reportedUsage.
The nested prompt_tokens_details is itself a null-prototype object (no inherited keys).
A malformed-but-object usage makes recordDispatchFinalForProvider append ONE unavailable-final that supersedes the preflight estimate.

adversarial.desc: An inherited Object.prototype.usage / cached_tokens / prompt_tokens does NOT leak into reportedUsage (own-property guards).
recordDispatchFinalForProvider never throws even when buildProviderRecord throws; the outer try/catch holds (openai + gemini).

items.title: Apply the comprehensive smoke covering all projection + unavailable-final + prototype-safety cases
items.context: Apply the complete packages/main/src/tasks/usage-ledger-codex-gemini-smoke.ts (captured in /tmp/fe1f-final/) -- it covers token-only projection (incl. transcript/extra-key drop, mixed-type keys, 50+ keys, minimal object, non-numeric value), cache-field preservation, null-prototype top + nested, own-property guards vs polluted Object.prototype.usage/usageMetadata/cached_tokens/prompt_tokens, and recordDispatchFinalForProvider malformed-object -> unavailable-final-supersedes + never-throws (openai + gemini). The npm script test:usage-ledger-codex-gemini already exists. The smoke must pass and full npm test must be green.
items.userSees: node packages/main/dist/tasks/usage-ledger-codex-gemini-smoke.js passes all checks; full npm test exits 0.
